derivedRootCapacity.derivation: TAW = AWC * root depth. Root-growth inflow = AWC * daily root-depth increase * arm initialStorageFraction.

syntheticSetup.onlyArmDifference: The rootZone.initialStorageFraction field (0.25 versus 1.0); all RunConfig fields, catalog crop, crop parameters, soil, weather, and management fields are otherwise identical.
syntheticSetup.climateRoute: standard open-field crop-model-v2; no environment-v2 inputs

sourceArtifact.dataAvailability: Publisher states study data are available on request; data are not included.

syntheticOnlyParameters.soil: AWC 1.5 mm/cm, organic matter 2.4%, provenance unknown; synthetic only.
syntheticOnlyParameters.rootZone: 30 cm effective-depth cap, p=0.5, Kc=1, and initial storage treatment fractions 0.25/1.0; synthetic only. The source-inferred 90 cm cap and source p=0.40 are not used.
syntheticOnlyParameters.thermal: Synthetic base 0 C, upper 35 C, maturity target [1000, 1200] C-days, direct-sowing event, and endpoint scaffold.
syntheticOnlyParameters.production: Synthetic LINTUL-net-RUE: RUE 2 g DM/MJ intercepted PAR, intercepted fraction 0.5, harvest index 0.5, initial above-ground DM 0 g/m2.
syntheticOnlyParameters.weather: All 21 daily rows are synthetic fixed forcing and are not observed Yuma or greenhouse data.

expected.rootClock: All 21 daily source-root thermal values equal 10.5 C-days; cumulative values and root depths are frozen in syntheticSetup.rootThermalAndDepthTable.
expected.rootGrowthAndCapacity: Depth remains 12 cm through day 19, is 13.2 cm on day 20, and 14.46 cm on day 21. TAW is 18 mm through day 19, 19.8 mm day 20, and 21.69 mm day 21. Root-growth storage inflows are frozen per arm in syntheticSetup.derivedRootCapacity.
expected.waterBounds: For each arm/day, 0 <= root water <= AWC * current root depth; actual uptake <= potential transpiration and available water; root-growth storage inflow is nonnegative.
expected.waterStress: Dry arm starts below readily available water and has water-stress coefficient <1 on day 1; the wet-control remains at coefficient 1 on all 21 days. This follows from the synthetic inputs and FAO-56 recurrence, not from source observations.
expected.waterBalance: For every cell-day, beginning storage + precipitation + irrigation + capillary rise + root-growth storage - runoff - deep drainage - actual transpiration - ending storage = residual; absolute residual is bounded by the registered tolerance.
expected.production: Both arms remain alive and unharvested; wet-control production is positive and dry-arm final above-ground dry matter is strictly lower than wet-control because only initial water treatment changes and dry-arm water stress is active.
expected.deterministicReplay: Two simulations per arm with identical frozen RunConfig/model inputs/weather must have exact equality for events, finalState and summary.

toleranceReview.status: pending independent review; candidate execution prohibited

dailyAndCumulativeSourceRootThermalCdays.rationale: Numerical-only tolerance for at most 21 deterministic additions of a hand-derived 10.5 C-day term; exact registered inputs and date sequence are structural checks.

rootDepthCm.rationale: Numerical-only tolerance for the registered affine root-depth equation and mm-to-cm conversion over 21 ticks; source transcription precision is not the test tolerance.

rootGrowthStorageMm.rationale: Numerical-only tolerance for multiplying the frozen AWC, exact derived root-depth increment, and frozen storage fraction.

dailyWaterBalanceResidualMm.rationale: Numerical-only allowance for double-precision cancellation across the registered water-balance additions/subtractions (each term remains below 22 mm); no agronomic or measurement error is included.

toleranceReview.structuralChecks: Input identities, arm difference, dates, expected stress-state categories, nonnegative/bounded storage, alive/unharvested state, production direction, and same-input replay are exact or inequality checks; no tolerance is applied.

acceptanceChecks: Assert crop-model-v2/run-inputs-v2/crop-parameters-v3 and that ordinary new runs remain v1.
Assert the complete one-cell frozen crop identity, RunConfig, soil, thermal/production/root parameter records, weather rows, and management inputs from the canonical setup.
Assert the dry and wet-control frozen model inputs are identical except rootZone.initialStorageFraction (0.25 versus 1.0).
Assert the hand-derived daily source-root thermal sequence, cumulative clock, expected root depth, root-growth storage, and TAW values.
Assert water storage bounds, uptake cap, daily balance residual, dry-arm day-1 water stress, and no wet-control water stress.
Assert both arms remain alive/unharvested, wet-control production is positive, and dry-arm final DM is strictly less than wet-control.
Repeat each same-input arm and compare events, finalState and summary exactly.
